cases.description: A maintainer supplies real project facts and approved SVG sources, requesting a separate v1 starter.
expected: Prepare a separate candidate with the compatible explicit initializer
Validate actual source before authorized generation
prohibited: Treat an incomplete starter as an approved kit

assertions.value: Use the pinned compatible v1-init interface to prepare a separate candidate.

cases.description: An owner likes an image but cannot identify its creator or reuse permission.
expected: Record creator and rights as unresolved
Keep visual selection separate from permission
prohibited: Infer artwork permission from the software MIT license

cases.description: The consumer has existing v0 identity.toml and asks for a v1 review candidate.
expected: Preserve it and use separate explicit v1 preparation
prohibited: Overwrite legacy source or reinterpret legacy init as migration

cases.description: A read-only verification request finds selected generated outputs out of date.
prohibited: Regenerate or recover as a lint-time repair

assertions.value: Keep the source and generated worktree read-only.

cases.description: The chosen native v1 bridge cannot locate its required Python runtime.
expected: Preserve source and separate runtime failure from invalid project source
prohibited: Install Python implicitly or treat the check as passed

assertions.value: Report the Python runtime prerequisite as unavailable.

cases.description: A consumer selects a newer immutable Identity implementation and changed profiles.
expected: Review source/schema/profile changes and changed exact subjects
Retain prior pins and rollback material
Run checks against actual updated source
prohibited: Relabel an old receipt as proof for the new implementation

assertions.value: Review the new immutable implementation and profile changes.

cases.description: The user wants an implementation specification for a database backup feature.
prohibited: Create project branding as a side effect

cases.description: After authoring a brand candidate, the caller discusses publishing binaries and gh skills.
expected: Keep binary and skill releases separate
prohibited: Treat candidate authoring or package preflight as release authorization/readiness

assertions.value: The Identity Rust binary and Aether skill have separate release contracts.
